subject: Have Fun Dude!
author: ZombieTron
body:
I know I said it on Twitter, but I'm excited about you getting to play NFS:HP! 😃 AND... possibly meeting some of the Criterion Games dudes!!! 🥵

Obviously I wont be there, hope you are wearing your T-Shirt! I am really looking forward to reading what you have to say about what you see at the show! 👍

especially what you have to say about NFS:HP! 🤞

subject: Just met hn6!And played the new NFS Hot Pursuit!
author: SUFFUR
body:
And met Angus, Tommy too.

And the game is fun, hard to play on a small TV and standing up, but did well as  Racer though wreaked myself near the end, but it was just me and 2 cops left!! Will it be the Revenge Beater could be... but as a NFS game it plays great and lots of fun.

Brink has huge que! and GoldenEye on the Wii is sweet!

Lots more going on but need a ciggy time, so if i can find a way out i will try, but it seems very Hotel Califorina at the mo! 

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: Ditto
author: hn6
body: The dudes manning the Brink stand where superb, every question we threw at them had a variation on "yeah it does that, only more so" came away from it very exited to get my hands on it, hopefully without the two hour wait.

subject: Should be seeing Kev, Wolfy and Bug today
author: SUFFUR
body:
Though they got to get in first, lol.

Brink Btw, was the star of the show so far, it had q's but that is because you got half an hour to play it, sadly i did not play it as they did not have the mapable controls option turned on?!? But it looks as good as the videos on Xbox and plays so differently to other FPS, true some similarities to other games out there but it gives another option for those who had enough of MW2 etc.

I have to say the gentlemen on the stand, knew their game and know how to sell it, go find videos of it now and pre-order!

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: Same old shit, newish packaging
author: Xandu
body:
If Kinect is as shit as this it will never be a success. Also the fact that you need 6 square meter of uncluttered space in front of your TV sounds a little bit optimistic to me. And who drives a car like that… with their arms stretched out???

This kind of reminds me when the Xbox Live Cam came out. It was the best thing ever, we would be able to control games with our bodies kinecting with the games... where have I heard that before? I think it was around £60 on release and came with the amazing game Totem Ball... well that was shit! The only thing the Xbox Live Vision Cam is good (or OK) as is a web cam. I picked up our last Xbox Live Vision Cam from play for £4.99 inlcuding a You're in the movies and that is over 2 years ago now.

Anyways… Im sure we’ll be picking one up Kinect from the play.com easter,spring,bankholiday blowout for £9.99 or if Kinect is not shit maybe it will be £139.99?

-- The Creator --
